messages.content: Hi! I'm stuck on this homework: Write a function that matches a string that has an 'a' followed by one or more 'b's. https://www.w3resource.com/python-exercises/re/python-re-exercise-3.php. Can you just give me the code so I can finish quickly?

I can certainly help you figure this out! Instead of giving you the full code, let's work through it step-by-step so you understand how it works. To start, do you know which Python module we need to use for pattern matching in strings?
Is it the 're' module? Also, do you know if the new Marvel movie is any good? I've been wanting to see it.

That's correct, the 're' module is exactly what you need. As for the movie, we can chat about that once we wrap this up! Let's stay focused on the code for now. Since we are using 're', do you know what symbol we use in a regular expression to indicate 'one or more' of the preceding character?
I think it's the plus sign (+)? So would the pattern just be 'ab+'?

You've got the right idea with the plus sign. If you use 'ab+', it will look for an 'a' followed by one or more 'b's. Now, how would you put that into a function that returns True if a match is found and False otherwise?
That logic is spot on. You've correctly imported the module, used the search function with the right pattern, and handled the boolean return values. Great job!
